text:
sanjay.k: Quick heads-up — planning to stage a precision toggle for rw-llm-7b tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: enable fp16 as the default execution profile, with an int8 fallback for long-context or cost-sensitive requests. Need to lock guardrails and canary audiences.

sanjay.k: Proposed rollout plan: 1) 5% internal traffic (dev + se2) for 2 hours, 2) 1% production traffic for 6 hours, 3) expand to 25% prod if no regressions, then gradual ramp. Auto-rollback rules below.

sanjay.k: Config snippet I pasted into the feature flag UI (rough):
```
flag: quant_precision_profile
scope: model:rw-llm-7b
variants:
  - name: fp16_default
    rollout: 5% internal -> 1% prod
  - name: int8_fallback
    condition: tokens > 4096 or cost_per_request > $0.10
    rollout: 100% for matches
slo_checks:
  - latency_p50 <= 200ms
  - error_rate <= 0.5%
rollback_triggers:
  - quality_drop_absolute > 1.5 BLEU/EM (on eval set)
  - latency_increase > 20%
  - error_rate_increase > 0.5pp
monitoring: telemetry-tag: quant-flag, trace-sample: 1%
```

deploy-bot: draft toggle created: quant_precision_profile (id: ff_8429). Canary window reserved for 1765480000 - will post update when canary starts.

maya.p: thanks — do we have an eval harness and small prompt set to catch generation regressions? need to avoid hallucination spikes.

sanjay.k: yes — using eval-suite/production/llm_quality_rw7b_v1 (200 prompts, span relevance + factuality). We'll run the suite after the internal phase and after 1% prod.

alex.t: can we add a synthetic perf load to capture tail latency under batching? suggest ramping QPS in the internal phase and include 95/99 latency checks.

lina.z: telemetry: make sure logs include `quant.profile` tag and KV-cache hit rate metrics. Also please add a verbose tracing slice for first 50 requests in canary so we can debug layer-level perf.

ops-bot: scheduled maintenance window check: 09:00-11:00 PT is clear. No infra deploys in that window.

maya.p: pinging rw-observability team — @alex.t @lina.z tag them on the PR so alerts are wired.

alex.t: I'll add dashboards: per-model token cost, p50/p95/p99 latency, error rate, hallucination score (from eval harness). Also will add a regression alert rule: if hallucination_score increases by >10% relative to baseline, auto-notify #incidents and pause rollout.

sanjay.k: good. One more guardrail: if throughput (tokens/sec) drops by >15% on same instance size, rollback.

maya.p: can you post the PR with the feature-flag change + canary checklist? I'll review today.

sanjay.k: PR: https://git.redwood.dev/rw/infra/+/I4829 (flag + observability hooks). Please review and add comments.

deploy-bot: canary job queued. Hold until PR approved and monitors green.

lina.z: quick question — for int8_fallback condition, are we evaluating on request size only or cost estimate? cost_estimate isn't available in the gateway yet.

sanjay.k: good catch. change to `tokens > 4096` for now. we'll follow up to add cost-based routing in next pass.

alex.t: review complete, left 2 minor comments about alert thresholds.

maya.p: approved from product QA side.

sanjay.k: thanks all — schedule remains 09:00 PT tomorrow. I'll post canary start/stop messages and the boxed results. tagging owners: @maya.p (quality), @alex.t (obs), @lina.z (telemetry). :thumbsup:

ops-bot: canary start ETA: 1765480000.

sanjay.k: if anyone wants to join live for the 1% prod phase, I'll be in #eng-ml at start. otherwise I'll post the summary thread after the run.

maya.p: will monitor too. good plan. :raised_hands:

alex.t: spinning up perf harness now, I'll post baseline numbers before canary.

lina.z: I'll add the trace sampling and dashboard panels this afternoon.

sanjay.k: cool — thanks everyone.
